leads.name: Rockefeller Tree (the Tall Tree)
leads.reason: Named specimen on the Big Trees Trail in Rockefeller Forest, held the world's-tallest-tree title 1957 onward per search summaries; could not find a second directly-fetched source with real figures within the time box (famousredwoods.com and redwoodhikes.com both returned no usable body text to the fetch tool; only search-summary-level facts were available, which BRIEF_RESEARCH.md rules out as a source). Worth a retry from a session that can reach those pages, or via monumentaltrees.com in a browser session.

leads.name: Stratosphere Giant
leads.reason: 4th-tallest measured living redwood (Wikipedia, 112.94m/370.5ft, measured 2004), somewhere in Rockefeller Forest. Not researched for a precise, publicly-accessible location this pass; some very tall redwoods have deliberately unpublicized locations to protect them from damage (per the Hyperion/Grove of Titans precedent), so its exact accessibility needs checking, not assuming, before treating as a candidate.
